turns.assessment: The outage is a simultaneous, network-wide interruption of services whose working ODU paths transit S08, while optical power, OSNR, pre-FEC BER, DGD, SOP and amplifier telemetry remained unchanged across the relevant line systems. Services terminating at S08 remain healthy, which further localizes the failure to transit switching rather than the optical layer. A failure of the S08 OTN switch fabric best explains the broad ODU-level impact without optical symptoms; ROADM port/channel faults would have degree- or channel-specific effects.

proposals.rationale: Every affected working path depends on otn.S08, and the simultaneous interruption across many unrelated endpoints and optical channels matches failure of all ODUs cross-connected through that switch. Unchanged optical telemetry strongly excludes fibre, amplifier, line-interface and ROADM optical faults.
